title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
lineage: AudMC(AKG 1000 mic > Sony 110 deck, TDK C-120SD master cassettes)  > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: An outstanding audience recording captures the high‑energy July 31 1973 Roosevelt Stadium show with smoking China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Bertha, Greatest Story Ever Told, Loose Lucy and a soulful Black Peter.
ai_review.review: This 1973 audience tape delivers an exhilarating performance—Jerry’s birthday night was packed with fire, highlighted by a blistering China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, a tear‑jerking Bertha into The Greatest Story Ever Told, and the most smokin’ Loose Lucy many fans have heard.  The crowd is front‑and‑center, giving the recording an immediacy that makes it feel like you’re there, while the overall sound quality is impressively clear for an AUD from the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews average ~4.8 stars; overwhelmingly positive comments about both show energy and recording clarity, with many highlighting standout performances.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Presence of crowd noise adds immediacy; sound is clear and well‑balanced for a 1973 audience tape, occasional tinny venue tone but overall very listenable with no major dropouts.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds strong momentum that carries into an explosive second set; seamless transitions and a climactic Truckin' finale keep the energy soaring.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia was 'partying hard' on his birthday, delivering loose, ecstatic solos (notably on Truckin') that thrilled the audience.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass solo around the 9‑minute mark was praised; fans felt the stage vibrate with his powerful chords.
